records.candidate_name_role: Supported representative receiving-river/system identity; the small chosen headward feeder is not independently named and no uniform scalar name is assigned.
records.geographic_disambiguation: The selected Amapá corridor supports Rio Cunani as its representative river-system name. Official municipal cartography follows the chosen southern headwater setting through Carnot and Cunani village to the Atlantic mouth; the Cabo Orange management plan independently confirms the named river and settlement/mouth relationship. The small initial feeder is not independently named, and the two stored ending contexts remain separately described. No automatic or product name application is made.
records.completion_scope: Both retained mainstem fragments, FIDs11595(stage3) and11596(stage2), and all48 stored parts have ordinary headwater-to-Cunani-mouth correspondence. The short initial feeder stub is slightly offset from generalized drawn linework; the immediate mapped receiving corridor supports the bounded inference without an indicated interbasin gap. Source and render endings occupy separately described sides of the Cunani coastal mouth.
records.supported_name_scope: Rio Cunani is supported as the representative connected receiving-river identity. The initial small headward feeder has no separately established name, and the source/render mouth extensions are geographic endpoint contexts rather than independently named reaches. Lateral Igarapé Mocambo and Rio Novo are excluded from candidate aliases.

scope_limits: The immediate headward receiving connection is an ordinary-scale inference across the small displacement between the first stored stub and the mapped headwater line. No exact alignment or separately named initial feeder is established.
Source and render endings occupy different sides of a generalized river-mouth/coastal setting; neither is asserted to be a surveyed mouth point, current bank or exact wet-channel location.
Both map products are generalized compilations and share some Brazilian base lineage. Agreement does not imply two independent hydrographic field surveys.
Historical tidal statements do not establish current navigation, discharge, tidal timing or precise tidal limits. Formal registry status remains unverified.

reconstruction_rule: Start from the pinned r46 cumulative index and apply later append-only deltas in verified commit order, rejecting duplicate IDs. Keep base records, scope clauses, region qualifiers and assessment histories unchanged. Apply explicit status-list changes. Subtract all recorded IDs from the exact eligible initial inventory to recover unrecorded targets; pending IDs remain recorded but are not completed source reviews.
publication_boundary: Own factual name/scope findings, public official URLs, bounded geometry metadata and public continuity pins only. No original maps, crops, complete coordinates or private source/derivative/registration fingerprints. Official hosting does not establish source redistribution rights.

research_order.progress_rule: Follow the actual continental order: Americas, Asia, Africa, Europe, then other, with all rivers before lakes. Preserve original queue IDs and ranks for continuity; apply documented geographic deferrals without counting them as name research, and place deferred objects into their corrected later phase by length-descending, stable-ID order. Prior candidate and scope-held assessments remain unresolved where stated.
